trends.title: AI system learns to keep warehouse robot traffic running smoothly
trends.summary: This new approach adapts to decide which robots should get the right of way at every moment, avoiding congestion and increasing throughput.

trends.title: Cognichip wants AI to design the chips that power AI, and just raised $60M to try
trends.summary: The firm says it can reduce the cost of chip development by more than 75% and cut the timeline by more than half.

trends.title: Mercor says it was hit by cyberattack tied to compromise of open source LiteLLM project
trends.summary: The AI recruiting startup confirmed a security incident after an extortion hacking crew took credit for stealing data from the company's systems.

trends.title: Salesforce announces an AI-heavy makeover for Slack, with 30 new features
trends.summary: Slack just got a whole lot more useful.

trends.title: OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise
trends.summary: OpenAI's latest funding round, led by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, values the AI lab at $852 billion as it nears an IPO.

trends.title: Yupp shuts down after raising $33M from a16z crypto’s Chris Dixon
trends.summary: Less than a year after launching, with checks from some of the biggest names in Silicon Valley, crowdsourced AI model feedback startup Yupp is closing its business, the company said Tuesday.

trends.title: MIT researchers use AI to uncover atomic defects in materials
trends.summary: A new model measures defects that can be leveraged to improve materials’ mechanical strength, heat transfer, and energy-conversion efficiency.

trends.title: Wristband enables wearers to control a robotic hand with their own movements
trends.summary: By moving their hands and fingers, users can direct a robot to play piano or shoot a basketball, or they can manipulate objects in a virtual environment.

trends.title: How to create “humble” AI
trends.summary: An MIT-led team is designing artificial intelligence systems for medical diagnosis that are more collaborative and forthcoming about uncertainty.

trends.title: Anthropic took down thousands of GitHub repos trying to yank its leaked source code — a move the company says was an accident
trends.summary: Anthropic executives said it was an accident and retracted the bulk of the takedown notices.

trends.title: Meta’s natural gas binge could power South Dakota
trends.summary: Meta's upcoming Hyperion AI data center will be powered by 10 new natural gas plants.

trends.title: Less than a month: StrictlyVC San Francisco brings leaders from TDK Ventures, Replit, and more together
trends.summary: StrictlyVC San Francisco brings leaders from TDK Ventures, Replit, and more together on April 30. Space is limited. Register here for your pass.

trends.title: Anthropic is having a month
trends.summary: A human really borks things at Anthropic for the second time this week.

trends.title: Alexa+ gets new food ordering experiences with Uber Eats and Grubhub
trends.summary: You can now order from Uber Eats and Grubhub using Alexa+, an experience Amazon says will be similar to chatting with a waiter at a restaurant or placing an order at a drive-thru.

trends.title: Evaluating the ethics of autonomous systems
trends.summary: MIT researchers developed a testing framework that pinpoints situations where AI decision-support systems are not treating people and communities fairly.

trends.title: Preview tool helps makers visualize 3D-printed objects
trends.summary: By quickly generating aesthetically accurate previews of fabricated objects, the VisiPrint system could make prototyping faster and less wasteful.

trends.title: Seeing sounds
trends.summary: Mariano Salcedo ’25, a master’s student in the new Music Technology and Computation Graduate Program, is designing an AI to visualize and express music and other sounds.

trends.title: MIT engineers design proteins by their motion, not just their shape
trends.summary: An AI model generates novel proteins based on how they vibrate and move, opening new possibilities for dynamic biomaterials and adaptive therapeutics.

trends.title: Augmenting citizen science with computer vision for fish monitoring
trends.summary: MIT Sea Grant works with the Woodwell Climate Research Center and other collaborators to demonstrate a deep learning-based system for fish monitoring.

trends.title: Advancing international trade research and finding community
trends.summary: Sojun Park, a postdoc at the Center for International Studies, has learned much from his research on intellectual property as well as his interactions with students and mentors at MIT.
